featured_reviews.review_text: so i am living in yourspace hostel , the heritage building which is located in fort area ,south mumbai for around 1.5 yrs. i pay 33k per month for just a double sharing room(i would say just for a bed space), food is really bad, the maintainance and especially management is even worse. last month it had turned into a ratspace ....rat going into a coffee machine..climbing onto a fridge and what not. i was just going through there website now and most of the pictures are just fake. there are around 150 + girls in this hostel ..everyone is just so tired with everything and regretting their decision.i really want this review to be considered by the yourspace authority.....honestly not just students but now parents are also upset because of such management.i am attatching some pictures pls go through it before booking a room here.

featured_reviews.name: Twincle Halder
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve never experienced such blatant dishonesty from a company. It has been seven months since I moved out, and Your-Space PG has still not refunded my deposit. For months, they have fed me nothing but lies, repeatedly promising the refund and constantly delaying with one excuse after another. Now, they don’t even answer my calls.

I even filed a complaint with the consumer forum, and they lied to them as well! It’s beyond clear that they have zero respect for their customers and no intention of returning our hard-earned money. This business should be ashamed of its practices—if you’re considering staying here, beware of their deceit and think twice. whatever number you are replying here, you don't pick up the call ! i want my money to be credited in my account now!

featured_reviews.name: Aadhya
featured_reviews.review_text: It has been over three months since I vacated my room, yet I still have not received my security deposit refund. Despite numerous calls and emails, there has been no action taken. When payments are due, the hostel is quick to demand full payment upfront, but when it comes to refunds, there is an unacceptable delay. Additionally, when vacating, even a minor delay on our part is met with threats of daily fines of ₹10,000 and the risk of having our belongings thrown out. This double standard is extremely unfair and unprofessional. I request immediate action on this matter.

The services provided in the pg are substandard and the food is inedible there are rats running around in the canteen..clothes get lost in the laundry..etc etc.. we are from kolkata and my daughter is an advocate working in a big corporate house.
I thought I should write an honest review about the exorbitant rent they are taking and the behaviour of the managers and the pathetic services of the pg.

Admission first preference is given to the Anjuman Students and then the other institute students.though they serve only breakfast and dinner but the quality of the food is excellent. featured_reviews.name: Rafiya farheen
featured_reviews.review_text:
I took this PG for one month, but unfortunately I had to leave within just 3 days due to serious issues.
Firstly, the PG is not organized or properly managed by the owner, Mansi. There is no hygiene maintained. The washroom and washbasin are extremely dirty and unclean. The kitchen is not properly accessible — only a few people are allowed to use it, while others are restricted. You cannot cook properly.
This is the month of Ramzan, and when I raised concerns regarding basic facilities, my complaints were ignored. The warden clearly refused washing clothes saying, “If I get time, I will do,” which is very unprofessional. There is also theft happening — many residents’ belongings are going missing.
Most importantly, there is no proper space or freedom to offer namaz peacefully. When I complained about these issues, the warden behaved rudely and misbehaved. After the owner Mansi leaves, arguments continue till 2 AM, disturbing everyone and that cause me a mental Harrasement.
The warden is a 19-year-old girl from Nepal who does not understand our language properly and is not capable of managing the PG responsibly.
There is a prepaid system — if you pay for one full month, there is strictly no refund under any circumstances. Even though the facilities and commitments promised on the first day were not fulfilled, they refused to consider any refund.
Because of all this, I lost my full amount of ₹6,000 within just 3 days.
Overall, it was a very stressful and disappointing experience. Basic hygiene, proper management, safety, and respect for residents are completely lacking.

featured_reviews.name: Era Singal
featured_reviews.review_text: I stayed in this PG for two months. Warden's behaviour is mysterious and she treat everyone unfairly except a women Rehana. I was having fever and told them to reduce the coldness of AC but they denied.

featured_reviews.name: SimpleVibes
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Kurla PG offers good facilities and overall management, but there is a serious issue with the warden’s behavior. She shows clear favoritism towards a few girls (such as Rehna and Mohana) by doing their personal work and letting them control the lights, while treating others unfairly.
Additionally, late-night disturbances are common, with some residents talking on calls till 3 AM, making it difficult to study or sleep peacefully.
Management action is needed to ensure fair treatment and a peaceful living environment for all residents.
